environment.qualification_boundary: Normal install stale for detector/runner/schema. Fresh isolated source build is required before V2 ROS qualification; root agent is undertaking that separately. This inventory launches no ROS/Gazebo process and performs no build.

limitations: Primary v8.10 has no retained aggregate topology qualification.
v8.11/v8.12 local-basin optimizer_success=false despite passing historical topology gate. Revalidate a basin region prospectively; approximate center alone is no exact oracle.
Current parameter file paths may drift; recorded Git blob digests and resolved parameter files retain provenance.
Logged trajectories cannot establish counterfactual motion after earlier flags/changed controls.
M0 checks endpoint payload decoding and topic/count integrity; full-stream synchronization/frame/value/gap qualification is M1 work.

Extend existing analyzer and reader; no Gazebo needed.
